items.title: What sets AMD data centers apart as Intel stock keeps sliding?
items.summary:
Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) outpaced Wall Street estimates for the chipmaker's third quarter earnings, carried by the company's AI data center revenue nearly doubling to $8.55 billion

Defiance ETFs CIO Sylvia Jablonski helps The 8:30 team dive into and compare AMD's stock reaction to its data centers, while Intel (INTC) continues to plunge lower.

items.title: INTC Stock Dips Even After CEO Lip-Bu Tan Buys $9.7M Worth Of Intel Shares
items.summary: Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan has acquired roughly $9.7 million worth of company shares through a family trust, following an extensive stock selloff and a turbulent third-quarter earnings report.

items.title: Goldman Sachs’ $675 Target Says AMD’s Selloff Went Too Far
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGoldman Sachs trimmed its AMD price target to $675 from $700 and kept its Buy rating, a target 40% above Tuesday’s close. AMD shares are 28% below their October high after worries over AI spending and Intel’s weak PC guidance, even as AMD now expects revenue to grow more than 80% in 2027.

items.title: Strategy Gains 7% as Bitcoin Rallies After Midterms, CEO Touts “Bitcoin Capital Cycle”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysStrategy shares rose 7% today as Bitcoin and the broader market rallied after the midterm elections. CEO Phong Le ranked Strategy fourth among US stock sellers in 2026, calling it a “Bitcoin capital cycle.
